image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a modern steam iron. The body is primarily white with deep blue accents on the handle and upper casing. A translucent green water tank is visible near the front. The soleplate appears metallic but is partially obscured by shadow and angle. A power cord extends from the rear right. There is text/branding on the side of the white body.

artifact_observations.location: Side branding text on the white body
artifact_observations.reasoning: The brand name/logo text on the side is blurry and illegible, resembling AI-generated pseudo-text rather than crisp typography.
The green plastic appears overly smooth and lacks the subtle refraction or thickness variations expected in a real translucent plastic component.
The connection between the power cord and the body is slightly soft and lacks a defined strain relief bushing, appearing somewhat fused.
